task_question: Can a cutoff-safe whole observer distinguish organisation-preserving movement from organisational reconfiguration, retain explicit unresolved/non-evaluable states while the distinction develops, and measure what follows without hindsight?

population.unit: lawful adjacent final-returned structural update pair within one uninterrupted source segment
population.segment_head_rule: seven segment heads have no incoming occurrence and are excluded by construction
population.origin_anchor: max(final returned observer cutoff, candidate first-valid knowledge time)
population.carried_state_rule: bar-carried state without fresh structural update is not a new occurrence
population.intermediate_latent_rule: superseded/cleared intra-update emissions are not occurrences
population.missingness: retain AMBIGUOUS, NOT_EVALUABLE, NOT_COMPARABLE, CENSORED, QUARANTINED, OUT_OF_SCOPE and PROCESS_INVALID explicitly

all: D17 does not make the load-bearing fields non-evaluable

all: D16 nested local-vs-mesoscopic relation is evaluable and unchanged

candidate_generation_design.ambiguity_rule: If neither exact MATCH nor exact NON_MATCH rule is satisfied, retain the DMRP membership state implied by source/epistemic standing; never coerce to either class.
candidate_generation_design.threshold_rule: No new numeric movement, graduality, abruptness or low-net threshold is introduced.

consequence_pack_design.horizon_rationale: pre-C scale alignment to already-frozen K4/K8/K16/K32 and OPGS H4/H8/H16/H32 surfaces; not selected from task outcomes
consequence_pack_design.primary_measure_rule: At each horizon, use the last lawful current-segment returned observer state available as-of the horizon bar; compare the same frozen task invariant. A source break/release end censors rather than implying change.

simple_price_challenger.definition: Antecedent realised transition net displacement sign only: NEGATIVE, ZERO or POSITIVE; exact zero has no tolerance.

information_matched_structural_challenge.definition: Existing frozen OPGS low-expressivity atom (path_mode_against_start_frame, frame_event_after_path); no consequence-trained fitting.

whole_observer_candidate_partition.definition: MATCH vs NON_MATCH under the candidate rules above; unresolved states remain outside the binary contrast but remain in the complete denominator ledger.

dependence.overlap_rule: For each horizon h, two evaluable origins are dependent when their forward bar windows overlap within a source segment.
dependence.multi_horizon_rule: Rows from the same origin across horizons are one dependent family and never independent replications.
dependence.reporting: R4 must report raw rows, unique origins, overlap-connected components and per-segment support before any comparative conclusion.

support_and_decision_rules.engineering_pass: complete expected occurrence x horizon x measurement ledger, deterministic replay, zero silent missing rows, all censoring explicit
support_and_decision_rules.minimum_scientific_support: For a horizon to enter the primary contrast, each binary class must contribute at least 32 evaluable origins AND be represented in at least 4 source segments; otherwise that horizon is INDETERMINATE_SUPPORT.
support_and_decision_rules.primary_effect: delta_h = observed fraction TASK_INVARIANT_PRESERVED_AT_H in NON_MATCH_ORGANISATION_PRESERVED minus the same fraction in MATCH
support_and_decision_rules.horizon_support: MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE only when abs(delta_h) >= 0.10 and the sign of delta_h is the same in at least 4 source segments that contain both classes and evaluable outcomes.
support_and_decision_rules.global_support: SUPPORTED_DESCRIPTIVE_DIFFERENCE when at least 2 of 4 horizons are MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE with the same direction and no horizon meeting the materiality rule in the opposite direction.
support_and_decision_rules.global_null: NO_MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE only when all four horizons meet minimum support and abs(delta_h) < 0.10 at all four horizons.
support_and_decision_rules.comparator_rule: The same outcome ledger is partitioned by the price-sign and frozen OPGS-atom comparators. A whole-observer utility claim is not earned in R4 merely because its raw separation is larger; any later incremental/equivalence claim requires a separately frozen D protocol.
support_and_decision_rules.non_significance_rule: Non-significance or failure to cross the descriptive materiality rule never proves B redundancy.
